thread:
jess: Morning — planning to roll out a customer-scoped flag for ACME Corp today. Flag key is `customer_feature_x`. Canary target is 5% of accounts, but per-contract we need an explicit allowlist. Two quick q's: (1) Do subaccounts inherit allowlists? (2) For VIP users tied to the contract, do we bypass rate limits or just give feature access? @omar @lin

omar: For (1) subaccounts do NOT inherit by default; our rollout service scopes to `account_id`. If we want inheritance we can add `allow_subaccounts` as an option. For (2) VIPs should not bypass infra rate limits — only feature gating. If a bypass is required we need a separate exemption flow and SRE approval. Also: what's the allowlist format you expect?

jess: Sketching intended config below — this is the proposal not final: 
```json
{
  "flag_key": "customer_feature_x",
  "strategy": "allowlist",
  "accounts": ["acme-main-account-id"],
  "contracted_vip": true,
  "canary_percent": 5
}
```
Not final. Need safe kill switch and auto-fallback to `stable-v1` when rollback triggers.

lin: Agree on kill switch. Suggest we wire a latency/error rollback condition: if p95 > 200ms or error_rate spikes > 1% for 60s then auto-rollback. We already have `feature_toggle_monitoring` but it's not enabled for contract-scoped toggles by default — can we add logging to the rollout metadata?

kate: Heads-up from legal: contract gating needs an audit trail showing contract id, signed start date, and approver. Also confirm we don't expose internal debug headers or stack traces in responses for ACME accounts.

rollout-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start queued for 1865432100 + 5m by pipeline `rollout/canary-v2`. Link: https://deploys.redwood/1865432100

omar: Small schema nit — change `contracted_vip` to `vip_override` to match our feature flag schema. Also add `allow_subaccounts`: false (explicit).

jess: Updated config (proposal v2):
```json
{
  "flag_key": "customer_feature_x",
  "strategy": "allowlist",
  "accounts": ["acme-main-account-id"],
  "vip_override": true,
  "allow_subaccounts": false,
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "rollback_policy": "auto",
  "rollback_conditions": [
    "error_rate>1%",
    "p95_latency>200ms for 60s"
  ]
}
```
If nobody objects I'll flip the gate at T+10.

lin: +1. Also add telemetry tag `contract:ACME-2025-04` to rollout metadata so we can filter traces.

kate: +1 from legal if audit fields are included. Also ping support to prep VIP handling runbook.

mike: support: On it — I'll prepare a short VIP runbook (how to triage, escalation path, contact matrix) and stand by in #support during the canary. Do you want an SLA deviation playbook attached too?

jess: Yes please attach runbook to the rollout doc once ready. I'll also add the `audit.contract_id` and `audit.approver` fields to the rollout metadata.

rollout-bot: Canary started: audience = 5% (12 accounts). Monitor URL: https://telemetry.redwood/rollouts/1865432100 — live metrics streaming.

jess: OK, monitoring up. I'll watch alerts and hand off to support if anything noisy shows. Thanks all — will post final status here after 30m.
